name: Engadin Airport (Samedan)

runway.v: one runway, 03/21, 1,840 m long and 40 m wide, asphalt/concrete

hours.v: open 0600Z to 1700Z in summer and 0700Z to 30 minutes after sunset in winter
hours.quote: Airport opening hours summer: 0600Z to 1700Z ... Airport opening hours winter: 0700Z to SS+30min

curfew.v: no night operations; closed outside opening hours (summer 0600Z-1700Z, i.e. 08:00-19:00 local; winter from 0700Z, i.e. 08:00 local, to 30 minutes after sunset)

ppr.v: PPR for IFR approaches with piston-engine aircraft and for multiple (training) IFR approaches
ppr.quote: PPR for IFR APCH with piston engine aircraft. ... PPR for multiple IFR APCH (training).

noise.v: operators must check that the aircraft type's noise class is allowed at Samedan
noise.quote: Make sure that the type of aircraft (noise class) is allowed to operate at Samedan airport.

customs.v: customs clearance available at all times during opening hours (summer 08:00-19:00 local; winter 08:00 local until the end of evening civil twilight)
customs.quote: Customs clearance is available at all times during the hours of operation.

handling.v: the airport company itself provides ground handling, under its standard ground handling agreement
handling.quote: Engadine Airport offers all its guests a comprehensive bespoke service

notes: Source is the operator's pilot familiarization briefing (v09/2025), which itself says to use the official AIP/VFR manual for flight preparation; the Swiss eAIP (skybriefing) is paid and was not used. Hours are given in UTC: summer 0600-1700Z = 08:00-19:00 CEST; winter opens 0700Z = 08:00 CET and closes 30 min after sunset, so the winter closure starts earlier than 19:00 (windows_local shows the summer window only; winter evening closure varies with sunset). Elevation 5,600 ft AMSL (2022 briefing v7.10: 'Elevation 5‘600 ft AMSL'). The briefing header shows coordinates 46°32'6"N 9°53'6"E, but not as an AIP ARP, so geo was left out. Re-researched 2026-10-29: 29 Oct 2026: Operating-times page (modified 13 Dec 2025): 'Summer schedule: from 08:00 to 19:00 local time (LT)'; 'Winter schedule: from 08:00 local time (LT) till the end of evening civil twilight'; open 365 days a year. Customs hours follow these, so the winter evening end varies (hours_local shows the summer window). Customs is provided by the federal customs office (FOCBS) per the customs page (modified 5 Aug 2026). Ground handling page modified 26 Dec 2025; it does not say whether handling is mandatory. During WEF Davos (Jan 2026) PPR was mandatory for flights to/from LSZS (event-only; check the airport's WEF page each year). An old airport-hosted copy of the AIP (2016) exists at aip.engadin-airport.ch but is superseded and blocked to readers. Do not name the handler company on the public site (site rule).
